diagram.manim_description: On a BG canvas draw four rectangles one below the other, all left edges at x = 0, y pointing down, 1 unit = 54 px. Rectangle 2: 12 wide, 2 high, top edge at y = 2.2. Rectangle 3: 8 wide, 3 high, top edge at y = 5.4. Rectangle 4: 6 wide, 4 high, top edge at y = 9.6. Under each rectangle, starting 0.2 unit below its bottom edge and left-aligned at x = 0, write one INK tag with its sides, then (2.4 units to the right) one ANSWER tag with its perimeter: '1 × 24' then '50 units'; '2 × 12' then '28 units'; '3 × 8' then '22 units'; '4 × 6' then '20 units'. After the tag '50 units' write the word 'greatest' in FOCUS, and after the tag '20 units' write the word 'least' in FOCUS. Draw a dashed FOCUS outline (3 px, 0.15 unit outside the edges) around rectangle 1 and around rectangle 4. Text height at least 34 px.
